lines.gurmukhi: ਅਟਲ ਅਖਇਓ ਦੇਵਾ ਮੋਹਨ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: atal akhaio devaa mohan alakh apaaraa ||
lines.translation: You are eternal and unchanging, imperishable, invisible and infinite, O divine fascinating Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਨੁ ਪਾਵਉ ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਰੇਨੁ ਦਾਸਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੬॥੨੨॥
lines.transliteration: daan paavau sa(n)taa sa(n)g naanak ren daasaaraa ||4||6||22||
lines.translation: Please bless Nanak with the gift of the Society of the Saints, and the dust of the feet of Your slaves. ||4||6||22||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਆਘਾਏ ਸੰਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tripat aaghaae sa(n)taa ||
lines.translation: The Saints are fulfilled and satisfied;

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਜਾਨੇ ਜਿਨ ਮੰਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur jaane jin ma(n)taa ||
lines.translation: they know the Guru's Mantra and the Teachings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa kee kichh kahan na jaaee ||
lines.translation: They cannot even be described;

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਾਮ ਬਡਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kau naam badaaee ||1||
lines.translation: they are blessed with the glorious greatness of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਲੁ ਅਮੋਲਾ ਲਾਲੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: laal amolaa laalo ||
lines.translation: My Beloved is a priceless jewel.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਹ ਅਤੋਲਾ ਨਾਮੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: agah atolaa naamo ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: His Name is unattainable and immeasurable. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਿਗਤ ਸਿਉ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਮਾਨੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: avigat siu maaniaa maano ||
lines.translation: One whose mind is satisfied believing in the imperishable Lord God,

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh tat giaano ||
lines.translation: becomes Gurmukh and attains the essence of spiritual wisdom.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੇਖਤ ਸਗਲ ਧਿਆਨੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: pekhat sagal dhiaano ||
lines.translation: He sees all in his meditation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਜਿਓ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੋ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tajio man te abhimaano ||2||
lines.translation: He banishes egotistical pride from his mind. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਠਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: nihachal tin kaa thaanaa ||
lines.translation: Permanent is the place of those

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਛਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur te mahal pachhaanaa ||
lines.translation: who, through the Guru, realize the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadin gur mil jaage ||
lines.translation: Meeting the Guru, they remain awake and aware night and day;

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: har kee sevaa laage ||3||
lines.translation: they are committed to the Lord's service. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: pooran tripat aghaae ||
lines.translation: They are perfectly fulfilled and satisfied,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaj samaadh subhaae ||
lines.translation: intuitively absorbed in Samaadhi.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ਹਾਥਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bha(n)daar haath aaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord's treasure comes into their hands;

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੭॥੨੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak gur te paaiaa ||4||7||23||
lines.translation: O Nanak, through the Guru, they attain it. ||4||7||23||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੬ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ghar 6 dupade ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl, Sixth House, Dho-Padhay:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: chhod sagal siaanapaa mil saadh tiaag gumaan ||
lines.translation: Abandon all your clever tricks; meet with the Holy, and renounce your egotistical pride.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਵਖਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: avar sabh kichh mithiaa rasanaa raam raam vakhaan ||1||
lines.translation: Everything else is false; with your tongue, chant the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਰਨ ਸੁਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man karan sun har naam ||
lines.translation: O my mind, with your ears, listen to the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਟਹਿ ਅਘ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਵਨੁ ਬਪੁਰੋ ਜਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: mitahi agh tere janam janam ke kavan bapuro jaam ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The sins of your many past lifetimes shall be washed away; then, what can the wretched Messenger of Death do to you? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਦੀਨ ਨ ਭਉ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: dookh deen na bhau biaapai milai sukh bisraam ||
lines.translation: Pain, poverty and fear shall not afflict you, and you shall find peace and pleasure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਖਾਨੈ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨੁ ਤਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੨॥੧॥੨੪॥
lines.transliteration: gur prasaad naanak bakhaanai har bhajan tat giaan ||2||1||24||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, Nanak speaks; meditation on the Lord is the essence of spiritual wisdom. ||2||1||24||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੇ ਹੋਤ ਦੇਖੇ ਖੇਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinee naam visaariaa se hot dekhe kheh ||
lines.translation: Those who have forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord - I have seen them reduced to dust.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਬਿਲਾਸ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਤੂਟਤੇ ਏ ਨੇਹ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: putr mitr bilaas banitaa tootate e neh ||1||
lines.translation: The love of children and friends, and the pleasures of married life are torn apart. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਲੇਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man naam nit nit leh ||
lines.translation: O my mind, continually, continuously chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੂਖੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਦੇਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jalat naahee agan saagar sookh man tan deh ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You shall not burn in the ocean of fire, and your mind and body shall be blessed with peace. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਖ ਛਾਇਆ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਨਸਤ ਪਵਨ ਝੂਲਤ ਮੇਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: birakh chhaaiaa jaise binasat pavan jhoolat meh ||
lines.translation: Like the shade of a tree, these things shall pass away, like the clouds blown away by the wind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਮਿਲੁ ਸਾਧ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇਰੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਆਵਤ ਏਹ ॥੨॥੨॥੨੫॥
lines.transliteration: har bhagat driR mil saadh naanak terai kaam aavat eh ||2||2||25||
lines.translation: Meeting with the Holy, devotional worship to the Lord is implanted within; O Nanak, only this shall work for you. ||2||2||25||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੁਖਹ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸਤੋ ਨੀਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: purakh pooran sukhah daataa sa(n)g basato neet ||
lines.translation: The perfect, primal Lord is the Giver of peace; He is always with you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਉਸਨ ਨ ਸੀਤ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: marai na aavai na jaai binasai biaapat usan na seet ||1||
lines.translation: He does not die, and he does not come or go in reincarnation. He does not perish, and He is not affected by heat or cold. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man naam siu kar preet ||
lines.translation: O my mind, be in love with the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੇਤਿ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ਏਹ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: chet man mahi har har nidhaanaa eh niramal reet ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Within the mind, think of the Lord, Har, Har, the treasure. This is the purest way of life. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੀਧਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kripaal daiaal gopaal gobid jo japai tis seedh ||
lines.translation: Whoever meditates on the merciful compassionate Lord, the Lord of the Universe, is successful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਵਲ ਨਵਤਨ ਚਤੁਰ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਮਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਬੀਧਿ ॥੨॥੩॥੨੬॥
lines.transliteration: naval navatan chatur su(n)dar man naanak tis sa(n)g beedh ||2||3||26||
lines.translation: He is always new, fresh and young, clever and beautiful; Nanak's mind is pierced through with His Love. ||2||3||26||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਲਤ ਬੈਸਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗਤ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਚਿਤਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: chalat baisat sovat jaagat gur ma(n)tr ridai chitaar ||
lines.translation: While walking and sitting, sleeping and waking, contemplate within your heart the GurMantra.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਭਜੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: charan saran bhaj sa(n)g saadhoo bhav saagar utarahi paar ||1||
lines.translation: Run to the Lord's lotus feet, and join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. Cross over the terrifying world-ocean, and reach the other side. ||1||
